description: The >>FLAG-85 migration-flagging directive - a compiler-directive WINDOW: introduced in COBOL-2002, classified obsolete by the 2014 standard and REMOVED in COBOL-2023. THE EDGES ARE QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): COBOL-85 has no compiler directives, its compiler-directing forms being statements (§1985:IV.6.4.2.2.1: 'The compiler directing verbs are COPY, ENTER, REPLACE, and USE'); §2002:7.2.11 introduces the directive: 'The FLAG-85 directive specifies options to flag certain syntax that might be incompatible between the previous COBOL standard and the current COBOL standard', and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 56: 'A directive, FLAG-85, has been added that causes compiler flagging of language elements that may be incompatible between the previous COBOL standard and this International Standard.' §2014:7.3.12 keeps it and classifies it: 'NOTE The FLAG-85 directive is an obsolete element in this International Standard and is to be deleted from the next edition of standard COBOL' (§2014:F.2 item 1: 'There is no longer a need for the older FLAG-85 directive'), which fixes obsoleteIn=2014; Annex E.2 item 21 ('Obsolete elements') is the removal record: 'The following features that were classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard, have been removed from this Working Draft International Standard: - FLAG-85 - FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC - Standard Arithmetic - ...', which fixes removedIn=2023. The 2023 text carries NO general format for this directive; the 2002 and 2014 texts print it (§2002:7.2.11.1, §2014:7.3.12), and the row's operand is that format, diagnosed and acted on by FlagDirectiveProcessor + FlagConformancePass (kb/Work PB5600). Below 2002 the word is COBOL0900, at 2023 COBOL0902, at 2014 the COBOL0903 obsolete warning.

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2002:7.2.11.1 general format (a list of syntax-option words, or ALL, with ON/OFF; §2002:7.2.11.3 GR4 names the options) — a structured operand, diagnosed by its own stage as COBOL1622. The 2023 text carries no clause (Annex E.2 item 21 removed the directive); the 2002 and 2014 texts print the format.

vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:F.2 item 56); obsolete 2014 (§2014:F.2 item 1); removed 2023 (§2023:E.2 item 21, VCR row 28)
source:
>>FLAG-85 ALL ON
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725F8.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.

directivePlacement.text: The FLAG-85 directive may be specified only between clauses in divisions other than the procedure division and only between statements in the procedure division
